purpose: A single common-protocol public benchmark comparison; no provisional results are part of this protocol.

data_and_target.endpoint_rule: dataset-provided functional-failure endpoint; endpoint manifest frozen before training
data_and_target.target: RUL in cycles, endpoint_cycle minus current_cycle
data_and_target.public_processing: only the versioned scripts and manifests in d2pred_final/public_processing
data_leakage_controls: no unit appears in more than one outer split
endpoint and target manifests are frozen before model fitting
normalization fit on inner-training units only
test units are never used for tuning, early stopping or checkpoint selection

evaluation.outer_split: nested physical-device folds, identical folds for every model and seed
evaluation.inner_validation: device-wise validation split from outer-development units; fixed before training
evaluation.uncertainty: outer-fold and seed-ensemble summaries with validation-calibrated intervals
evaluation.test_use: one final evaluation after validation-based checkpoint selection

model_protocol.expert: manuscript-exact trend-fusion network, gradual-component encoder, twelve raw residual descriptors, token projection, three masked self-attention blocks, attention-guided fusion, Softplus output and joint loss
model_protocol.baselines: common raw-DI prefix and identical folds, seeds, target, tuning budget and stopping rules; architecture adaptations labelled in metadata
model_protocol.tuning_budget: fixed in advance; no test-based tuning; no model-specific extra search

required_outputs: figures regenerated only from verified predictions
execution_gate: Do not start until a human records approval of this exact protocol.
